# Everon campaign coordinate attribution

New Everon coordinate placements in docs/EVERON_CAMPAIGN_LOCATIONS.csv and the generated Chicken CivilianLocations.layer/MilitaryInstallations.layer adapt factual location data from Nick Ludlam / Bewilderbeest's EnfusionMapMaker:

https://github.com/nickludlam/EnfusionMapMaker/blob/main/Web/everon/everon-locations.js

Source blob: 1716e673b09e9facb5ca5288d0bcc7b36734ad52; retrieved 2026-10-24 through the GitHub connector. Source data was extracted for Arma Reforger; terrain/game updates can require placement adjustment.

Modifications by Open Resistance: select campaign settlements/outpost sites; assign stable IDs, city/town/outpost categories, display names, radii, starting roles, provisional gameplay populations and terrain grounding. Existing Provins, Morton and Lamentin coordinates come from this project's world files and retain their IDs. No external scripts or images are imported.
